about_the_game:
WELCOME TO BRAINROT ROYALE

Step into Brainrot Royale, the ultimate chaotic battle where your imagination collides with the unpredictable power of AI. Ever wondered who would win in a wild showdown between your favorite meme-fueled Italian characters? Time to find out. Pick your fighter and prove what you’re made of! Matches are up to 16 players at once!

YOUR GOAL

Rack up the highest score and crush the competition! Each match is a fast-paced, point-based free-for-all where eliminations are key. Master your character’s unique abilities, outsmart your rivals, and climb the scoreboard to claim victory!

FEATURES

  • Brainrot Characters

Play as the famous Italian Brainrot characters and duke it out between each other. Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Sahur, Bombardiro Crocodilo... you name it!

  • Iconic Locations

Battle across chaotic, meme-inspired maps like the mysterious Boscolini Fungolini or the sunny shores of Playa Nabolini. If they look familiar… it’s because they are. Just be warned: this is high-risk tourism, folks!

  • Power-Ups & Super Attacks

Collect powerful items scattered across the map to turn the tide in your favor. Grab the Super Attack Booster and unleash devastating abilities on your rivals!

  • Random Events

Expect the unexpected—random characters may crash the party to lend a hand, give you a boost, or throw a wrench in your plans.

JOIN US IN EARLY ACCESS

We’re building Brainrot Royale with our community. Got a favorite meme, character, or idea? Share it! Your feedback will help shape future updates and content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits May 2019
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
